label: Arab nations trade land for permission to build the third temple
description: Seen 10 July 2025 as the covenant of many: the Arab nations come alongside and agree a peace accord with Israel under which a third temple can be built, but only in exchange for giving up a stated amount of land. The land-for-temple exchange is the specific term.
aliases: you have to give so much land

label: Putin wants all of Ukraine and all of Poland
description: Given 9 July 2025 alongside the handful of cards image: that the Russian president wants all of Ukraine and then all of Poland in the days ahead. Poland is a NATO member, which makes this the most consequential single element in the war material.

label: A sectoral financial crash in Canada, and people leaving
description: Western influence shrinking, Canada in desperate need in the days ahead, a great financial crash and crisis coming to certain unnamed sectors of Canada that they cannot sustain, and people trying to leave the country.
